svg.title: Instant branching in Egres: CREATE DATABASE app2 TEMPLATE app is one manifest update that gives the new namespace tables and trees pointing at the same SSTables, and later writes to the branch produce files of its own
svg.desc: Database app has reserved schema tables, an orders table and its sku index, with trees pointing at SSTables f1 to f6, plus two unflushed writes in the shared memtables. CREATE DATABASE app2 TEMPLATE app adds one manifest entry to the Raft log. A new namespace app2 appears with the same tables and trees pointing at the same files, which now carry two references each, and the two unflushed writes are copied under app2. The memtables are shared by every namespace, so the copies sit next to the originals, keyed by app2. A write to app2 adds one more write there, and app sees none of it.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: EGRES · INSTANT BRANCHING · A NEW DATABASE THAT SHARES EVERY FILE WITH ITS SOURCE
